summary: Backend-only test of the News Banner feature (GET /api/news-banner, GET/PUT /api/admin/news-banner). 13/13 pytest cases passed against the public URL. Covered: A default state with no doc set (public and admin both return {image_url:'', caption:'', active:true}), B auth gating (no auth -> 401/403, invalid token -> 401/403, non-admin -> 403 with the DB left unchanged, admin -> 200), C PUT/GET round-trip with exact values, D active=false hides image and caption from the public endpoint while the admin endpoint keeps the stored values, and toggling back on restores public visibility, E clearing both fields, F trimming whitespace from image_url and caption (checked in Mongo too). Each test snapshots the news_banner doc and restores it afterwards.

minor.issue: image_url is not validated. Non-http values such as 'javascript:alert(1)' are accepted and stored (200). The spec says image_url is an http URL; consider requiring an http(s) scheme or an empty string and returning 422 otherwise.

action_items: Optional: validate the image_url scheme (http/https or empty) in NewsBannerRequest.
critical_code_review_comments: Implementation is clean: settings upsert, _id projected out, require_admin reused.

PUT with an empty body {} silently resets the banner to defaults, because every field has a default in NewsBannerRequest. This is acceptable for a full-replace PUT, but the admin UI must always send all fields.
seed_data_creation: Uses conftest seeded_admin (TEST_admin@example.com, is_admin=true) and seeded_user session fixtures, the same pattern as test_avr_privacy_contact.py. These are cleaned up after the run, and the news_banner doc is restored after each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: cd /app/backend/tests && set -a && . /app/frontend/.env && set +a && pytest test_avr_news_banner.py -v. Admin auth uses a seeded Mongo session token (is_admin flag); a real Google login for rao.jaiprakash@gmail.com was not exercised.
